description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home:* 3rd Floor Large Balcony* Electric Car Charger Available! * 6 Bicycles Included* Walk to Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach* 2 Master Bedrooms* Huge 12,000sqft Community Pool * FREE Seasonal Tram Service to the Beach and Pool * Snorkel the Grouper Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service *This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions. * **The Lagoon Pool will be resurfaced. This project will take approximately 4 weeks. Start date on this process is Monday, Oct 27th, 2025. The pool deck will be closed during this time as well due to the safety hazards during this project. We anticipate opening the complex on Monday, November 24th, 2025. During this time, our Neighbors at the Village of South Walton will be allowing the use of our wristbands at their pool complex. ***We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs January thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!Welcome to Casa de Cousins – Your Home Away from Home! Step into coastal comfort at Casa de Cousins, a beautifully designed and newly constructed 5-bedroom, 4.5-bath retreat that offers the perfect blend of relaxation and style. With its calming beach-inspired aesthetic, this spacious home invites you to unwind the moment you walk through the door. The first floor features an open-concept layout, ideal for quality family time. The living room, dining area, and fully equipped kitchen flow seamlessly together, with a half bath for convenience. Step out onto the back porch, which opens to a peaceful green space and walking path, a serene setting for sunrise coffee or a sunset cocktail. For added convenience, the home is also equipped with an electric vehicle charger, making it easy for guests with EVs to recharge during their stay. Upstairs on the second floor, you’ll find the laundry room, a cozy bunk room with a twin-over-twin bunk bed, and two master suites, each with a king bed and a private ensuite bathroom perfect for added comfort and privacy. The third floor offers even more space to spread out, including a guest bedroom with a king bed and another guest room featuring two full-over-full bunk beds, both with their own ensuite bathrooms. A large third-floor deck completes the space, ideal for sipping your morning brew or winding down with an evening drink. With room to sleep 16 guests comfortably, Casa de Cousins is the perfect backdrop for unforgettable beach vacations. Create cherished memories and start a new family tradition at this relaxing coastal getaway! Seacrest Beach Community is perfectly nestled between Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach on Hwy 30A. This luxury development offers an array of amenities including deeded beach access just across the street, a huge 12,000sqft community lagoon pool, an amphitheater, seasonal tram service to the beach or pool, and 1.35 miles of walking trails! The convenient location is within walking distance to world class dining, spas, wine bars, and many wonderful locally owned shops! Come see why friends and families vacation at Seacrest Beach year after year! *Parking passes will be provided equal to the number of bedrooms in the home. Not all parking spots are located directly by the home. Additional passes may be purchased for $50 each. Wristbands are required for use of the Seacrest Beach amenities and are limited to the maximum occupancy of the home. *The Bed Setup: 2nd FloorMaster Bedroom 1: King Bed Master Bedroom 2 King Bed Guest Bunk Bedroom: Twin/Twin Bunk Bed3rd Floor Guest Bedroom 3: King BedGuest Bedroom 4: 2 Full/Full Bunk BedsArea Attractions: Rosemary Beach is only minutes away, with shops and restaurants, including the Old-World style town center w/coffee shop, bike and surf rentals, and unique shops. Check out the open-air markets on the weekends. Enjoy the beautiful sugar white sand beaches that made 30A world famous. Enjoy walking and biking everywhere around Rosemary, Seacrest, and Alys. Don't miss the newly opened 30Avenue for even more dining and shopping options. 30Avenue is just north of Rosemary across Hwy 98, near both Shades Sports Bar and The Donut Hole. This laid-back, fun family atmosphere awaits you! Come stay and play and see for yourself what makes our community and the 30A area so special! The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted seabed. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
